entities.summary: The Western Australian Academy of Performing Arts (WAAPA) at Edith Cowan University (ECU) is a performing arts school located in Perth, Western Australia. Established in 1980, it is notable for being the most comprehensive performing arts school in Australia by disciplines of study and has produced some of Australia's most prominent graduates in the field.
